Name: Abrah's Princess Chicken (Major update)
Author: AbrahMods
Description:
👑 Princess Chicken Mod (Major 1.0.3update) 💕
[b]Version:[/b] 1.0.3
[b]Requirements:[/b] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI [/url]+ [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]
[line]
BIG UPDATE! VERSION 1.0.3:
-Royal mayo can now be added as a topping on any food you want! It will add a pink topping visual to your food and increase the price. Here's how: 
1. Press "esc" to open inventory menu

[img width=377,height=192]https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/1334937035856810025/1502736942977253478/2026-05-09_2.png?ex=6a00cc56&is=69ff7ad6&hm=80fc7fe0b934c04bac963a978c56f194d803c9a51590faa3c1f029a6882a732c&=&format=webp&quality=lossless&width=471&height=240[/img]

2. Take Royal Mayo and click it on the food you want
[img width=370,height=182]https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/1334937035856810025/1502737676074221639/2026-05-09_3.png?ex=6a00cd05&is=69ff7b85&hm=e04597c52281ae12ae7df03d704c1381da48145d27ee47c0108123f62c7653de&=&format=webp&quality=lossless&width=463&height=228[/img]

3.Done! Enjoy your food with a royal mayo topping
[img width=669,height=160]https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/1334937035856810025/1502737976759943359/2026-05-09_4.png?ex=6a00cd4d&is=69ff7bcd&hm=db4c259e99a6aa6806fca5e2c1ff7b7f2569ff5fca6174dc7c3c5c11e543fd10&=&format=webp&quality=lossless&width=836&height=200[/img]
[line]
🐣 Features
[list]
[*]Adds a [b]new chicken type[/b] purchasable from Marnie’s Ranch.[/*]
[*]Comes with [b]custom sprites[/b] for baby, adult, and egg.[/*]
[*]Produces [b]Princess Chicken Eggs[/b] daily.[/*]
[*]Eggs can be processed in the [b]Mayonnaise Machine[/b] to create [b]Royal Mayo[/b].[/*]
[*]Both the egg and mayo are [b]edible.[/b][/*]
[*]Fully compatible with Stardew Valley 1.6+.[/*]
[/list][line]
💎 Item Details:
[list]
[*]Princess Chicken Egg
[list]
[*]Sell Price: 120g[/*]
[*]Edibility: 40[/*]
[*]Energy: +90[/*]
[*]Health: +36[/*]
[/list][/*]
[*]Royal Mayo
[list]
[*]Sell Price: 600g[/*]
[*]Edibility: 60[/*]
[*]Energy: +135[/*]
[*]Health: +54[/*]
[/list][/*]
[/list]🏡 How to Obtain:

[list]
[*]Visit [b]Marnie’s Ranch[/b] and purchase your [i]Princess Chicken[/i].[/*]
[*]Raise it in a [b]Coop[/b].[/*]
[*]Collect its magical eggs daily.[/*]
[*]Process the eggs in a [b]Mayonnaise Machine[/b] to craft [i]Royal Mayo[/i].[/*]
[/list][line]
🌸 Installation
[list=1]
[*]Install the latest versions of [b]SMAPI[/b] and [b]Content Patcher[/b].
[/*]
[*]Download and extract this mod into your
[code]Mods[/code]folder.
[/*]
[*]Launch Stardew Valley.
[/*]
[*]Visit Marnie and buy princess chicken.
[/*]
[/list][i](Do not mix files with other Abrah mods. Each pack is standalone.)[/i]
[line]
✨ Created by [b]Abrah[/b]
